sceneConcept: An elegant thirty-year-old Chinese streamer agent stands alone against a transparent background, dressed more precisely than the talent she manages. Long black hair is tied in a smooth low ponytail; brown eyes, small stud earrings, restrained lipstick and exact makeup support a controlled professional expression. She wears a tailored deep-purple blazer over an ivory collared blouse, straight black trousers and polished black shoes. Holding a completely plain deep-purple smartphone at chest level, she lets the matching purple manicure remain clearly visible and pauses before looking up. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the portrait polished and grounded. Visual refresh: a sharply tailored purple jacket, pencil skirt and coordinated jewelry.
